feature.title: Let a customer rotate their own API key
feature.problem: Rotating a key means emailing support, who run a query by hand. It is slow for the customer and it is a production write nobody reviews.
nonGoals: Multiple simultaneous keys per account. One active key, one grace window.
A UI. This is the API the client will call.

surfaces.name: Rotate key
surfaces.purpose: Issue a new key and start a grace window on the old one.

surfaces.name: API keys
surfaces.purpose: The module that owns key issuance, hashing and expiry.

endpoints.purpose: Issue a new key; the old one keeps working for the grace window.
List the account's keys, prefix and status only — never the secret.
Revoke a key immediately, ending its grace window.

jobs.name: expire-grace-windows
jobs.onFailure: Logged and retried next hour; a missed run leaves an old key valid slightly longer, which is why the window is stored as an absolute time rather than a countdown.

components.why: Keys are stored hashed like passwords; argon2id is the default the rest of the service already uses.
